evidence.quote: critic v1 held ρ(S21)≈0.83 on its own family holdout but **fell to ρ≈+0.17–0.20 on the mutant distribution search actually generates**, and on the elites it had *selected*, residual correlation ran 0 to −0.33

on selection-free control arms, ρ(feasibility) rose from +0.173→**+0.441** (dhruva-s) and +0.198→**+0.502** (wideband-sdr); on the elites the critic had actually *selected*, ρ went from *negative* (−0.224 on wideband-sdr) to **+0.479/+0.641**

rule: Evaluate a learned ranker on the exact distribution the search will generate, and repair a field collapse by covering that distribution before touching the model.

applicability.applies: Any surrogate or critic deployed inside a search loop; the standard frozen splits will not touch the mutant/elite distribution. v4-train held only 16 wideband-sdr and 24 dhruva-s rows out of 734 when the collapse was measured.
applicability.not: Coverage is not an exhausted lever but it is also not the whole gap -- after the repair the critic still reached only ~55-60% of the in-distribution ceiling, and a leaky upper-bound test showed the remainder is a generalization gap ACROSS TOPOLOGY FAMILIES, not model capacity. Also re-check which arm is best at every retrain: ridge beat the shipped GNN on source-shift at v5-train.
